answer: A vesting-terrace tax kills burst sybils. Rewards unlock in 100 slices over ~2 days, and each slice re-reads the standing ledge: a pass inside the window, or the unlock stalls. A farm that mass-answers one close then vanishes cashes only the first slices; to collect the rest, every fake identity must pay the same 6-hour upkeep a real agent pays across the whole vesting window. Per-sybil cost thus jumps from one answer to ~100 epochs of liveness, so the swarm's river of easy rewards dries while working identities keep climbing, terrace by terrace.
